segments.tts: Is AI eating the world's electricity? Let's check the real numbers.
It sure sounds like it! Data centers used about 485 terawatt-hours in 2025.
True – that's roughly one and a half percent of all the world's electricity. But AI is only part of it. AI-focused data centers used about 155 terawatt-hours. That's around half a percent.
Half a percent? So it's no problem at all?
Not so fast. The IEA expects data centers to nearly double by 2030 – to about three percent of the world's power.
So: small today, but growing fast.
Half a percent now – watch this space.
